title: Evidence-coding dataset and reproducible D-by-V heatmap for intelligent process-parameter decision-making in polymer injection molding
description: Supporting data and reproducible Figure 4workflow for the review 'Intelligent Process Parameter Decision-Making in Polymer Injection Molding: From Initial Setting to In-Process Adaptation'. Version 1.1.0 contains only the 151 primary research publications. Primary D/Vassignments and the matrix are unchanged; literature cutoff27October2026 with historical query dates/windows preserved. English S1, matching evidence/method CSVs, input data, Python script, dependencies, reference heatmap, licenses and checksums are included. D and V refer to the same application; frequencies describe this selected narrative-review evidence set, not field-wide prevalence. No literature full texts, private author-review records, permission documents, correspondence or raw database exports are included. Data/documentation CC BY 4.0; Python code MIT; exact scope in LICENSE_DATA.txt and Supplementary/heatmap_generation/LICENSE. OpenAI Codex using GPT-6.1 (OpenAI) assisted author-led script refinement and consistency checks; scientific assignments are author-confirmed.
